items.title: Remove caravan and wooden extension from the plot
items.quote: Sie haben den auf dem Grundstück Fl.-Nr. 412/3 abgestellten Wohnwagen samt dem angebauten Holzvorbau bis spätestens 26.02.2027 zu entfernen.
items.computation: The Bescheid gives an explicit calendar date as the final deadline ('bis spätestens 26.02.2027') for the factual act of removing the caravan and wooden extension. This is a fixed date stated directly in the order, not a period to be calculated, so no counting rule or weekend/holiday adjustment applies to the act itself.

items.title: File Klage with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Wed); assumed posted the same day since no separate posting date is shown. Statutory Zugangsfiktion for a Bescheid sent by ordinary post is the 3rd day after posting under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG (the letter itself states 'vierten Tag', which conflicts with the statutory third-day rule — flagged in warnings). 18.11.2026 + 3 days = 21.11.2026 (Saturday); since the 3rd day falls on a Saturday, Bekanntgabe is deemed to occur on the next Werktag, Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Klage period then begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs. 1 BGB) and, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the Bekanntgabe day (23) → 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a regular weekday and not a Bavarian public holiday, so no further shift under §193 BGB is needed. Resulting deadline: 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (4th day), but Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG actually provides for the 3rd day after posting; I used the statutory 3-day rule to compute the Klage deadline, which lowers confidence in that date — please verify the actual posting/mailing date if possible.

The posting date of the letter was assumed to be identical to the printed document date (18.11.2026); if the letter was actually posted on a different day, the Bekanntgabe date and therefore the Klage deadline (23.12.2026) would shift accordingly.

A Zwangsgeld of 2.000 € is only threatened (angedroht) for non-compliance with the removal order by 26.02.2027; it is not yet due or payable and would require a separate enforcement notice if the deadline is missed.
